This scripture is speaking of King Saul as being before David, as the Lord had forsook Saul and even sent an evil angel to torment him (1 Samuel 16:14). Nathan, the prophet, was giving this Word from God to David, the King, that David would not build the Temple (1 Chronicles 17:4). Solomon, his son, was to build the Temple of God (1 Chronicles 17:11-12). David had proposed to build God the temple in Jerusalem, but God sent this word through Nathan, that David’s son Solomon would be the one to build the temple.

We need to praise God for His promises that He has given us in the Bible, as He keeps all of His promises, as He can not lie (Titus 1:2). When we are serving God like David did, with all of our hearts, He will make us promises, through His Word (the bible) just like He did to David through Nathan. If we will walk close to the Lord, then this verse will apply to us, as in the new testament Grace that we are under, we are the son’s of God (John 1:12), and His mercy and grace are upon us all if you are saved.
